```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)

plot_theme<-theme_classic()+
  theme(
    strip.background=element_blank(),
    strip.text.x=element_text(size=12,
                              hjust=0,
                              face="bold",colour="black"),
    strip.text.y=element_text(size=12,
                              hjust=0,
                              face="bold",colour="black"),
    panel.background=element_rect(fill="transparent"),
    panel.border=element_rect(fill="transparent",color="black",
                              linewidth=0.5),
    plot.background=element_rect(fill="transparent",color=NA),
    legend.background=element_rect(fill="transparent"),
    legend.position="none",
    # legend.title=element_text(size=16,face="bold"),
    legend.text=element_text(size=12),
    # axis.line.x=element_line(linewidth=1,color="black"),
    axis.line.x=element_blank(),
    axis.line.y=element_blank(),
    axis.ticks=element_line(linewidth=0.5,color="black"),
    axis.ticks.length=unit(-0.05,"in"),
    axis.title = element_text(size=12,
                              colour="black",face="bold"),
    axis.text=element_text(size=10,colour="black"),
    axis.text.x=element_text(angle=0,hjust=0.5,colour="black"),
    axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black"),
    plot.title=element_text(size=12),
    strip.placement="outside")
```

## VWC
```{r VWC data}
#### VWC Full data ####
vwc.20<-read.csv("final_data/SGS_EW_20cm_VWC.csv")

vwc.20.no.na<-vwc.20%>%
  # set date formats
  mutate(new.Date=as.Date(Full.Date,format="%m/%d/%y"),yr=year(new.Date),mon=month(new.Date))%>%
  mutate(short.Date=paste("2024",mon,day(new.Date),sep="-"))%>%
  mutate(short.Date=as.Date(short.Date,format="%Y-%m-%d"))%>%
  # rename variables from original file
  rename(TRT.2022=Trt_2022)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2022=factor(TRT.2022,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  rename(TRT.2023=Trt_2023)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2023=factor(TRT.2023,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  # select columns to keep
  select(c(new.Date,short.Date,yr,mon,Plot,TRT.2022,TRT.2023,VWC,Notes))%>%
  # drop rows with VWC NA's
  drop_na(VWC)%>%
  # create Unique_ID for dropping specific observations (outliers)
  mutate(Unique_ID=paste(new.Date,"_Plot",Plot,sep=""))

str(vwc.20) # 1900 observations
str(vwc.20.no.na) # 1900 observations

vwc.20cm.2024<-subset(vwc.20.no.na,yr=="2024")
vwc.20cm.2023<-subset(vwc.20.no.na,yr=="2023")
vwc.20cm.2022<-subset(vwc.20.no.na,yr=="2022")

```

```{r VWC Daily}
#### 2022 ####
dat<-vwc.20cm.2022
dat$resp<-dat$VWC

out.plot<-ggplot(dat,aes(x=as.factor(new.Date),y=resp,color=TRT.2022))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("darkorange4","steelblue4"))+
  theme_classic()+
  plot_theme+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1),
        legend.position="right")

out.plot

ext.22<-dat%>%
  group_by(new.Date,TRT.2022)%>%
  identify_outliers(resp)%>%
  filter(is.extreme==TRUE)
ext.22

mod.check<-lmer(resp~as.factor(new.Date)*TRT.2022+(1|Plot),data=dat)

plot(mod.check)
qqnorm(resid(mod.check));qqline(resid(mod.check))
shapiro.test(resid(mod.check)) # fails
leveneTest(resp~as.factor(new.Date)*TRT.2022,data=dat) # fails

outlierTest(mod.check) # One outlier 2022-07-05_Plot23 - not totally unreasonable in boxplot so leave in
# view(dat)
dat.22<-dat

#### 2022 mod ####
mod.check<-lmer(log(resp)~as.factor(new.Date)*TRT.2022+(1|Plot),data=dat)
plot(mod.check)
qqnorm(resid(mod.check));qqline(resid(mod.check))
shapiro.test(resid(mod.check)) # fails
leveneTest(log(resp)~as.factor(new.Date)*TRT.2022,data=dat)

anova(mod.check,ddf="Kenward-Roger")

#### 2023 ####
dat<-vwc.20cm.2023%>%
  filter(!Unique_ID %in% c("2023-08-29_Plot3"))
dat$resp<-dat$VWC

out.plot<-ggplot(dat,aes(x=as.factor(new.Date),y=resp,color=interaction(TRT.2022,TRT.2023)))+
  # scale_color_manual(values=c("orange","navy"))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("darkorange4","sandybrown","lightblue","steelblue4"))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()+
  plot_theme+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1),
        legend.position="right")
out.plot

ext.23<-dat%>%
  group_by(new.Date,TRT.2022,TRT.2023)%>%
  identify_outliers(resp)%>%
  filter(is.extreme==TRUE )
ext.23

mod.check<-lmer(resp~as.factor(new.Date)*TRT.2022*TRT.2023+(1|Plot),data=dat)
plot(mod.check)
qqnorm(resid(mod.check));qqline(resid(mod.check))
shapiro.test(resid(mod.check)) # fails
leveneTest(resp~as.factor(new.Date)*TRT.2022*TRT.2023,data=dat) # fails

outlierTest(mod.check) # two outliers 2023-08-29_Plot3 & 2023-08-29_Plot8 (both in the same trt at opposite ends) - removing high outlier (Plot 3) also stops second from being outlier
# view(dat)
dat.23<-dat

#### 2023 mod ####
mod.check<-lmer((resp)~as.factor(new.Date)*TRT.2022*TRT.2023+(1|Plot),data=dat)
plot(mod.check)
qqnorm(resid(mod.check));qqline(resid(mod.check))
shapiro.test(resid(mod.check)) # fails
leveneTest((resp^2)~as.factor(new.Date)*TRT.2022,data=dat)

anova(mod.check,ddf="Kenward-Roger")

# step(mod.check) # no reduction

#### 2024 ####
dat<-vwc.20cm.2024
dat$resp<-dat$VWC

out.plot<-ggplot(dat,aes(x=as.factor(new.Date),y=resp,color=interaction(TRT.2022,TRT.2023)))+
  # scale_color_manual(values=c("orange","navy"))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("darkorange4","sandybrown","lightblue","steelblue4"))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()+
  plot_theme+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1),
        legend.position="right")
out.plot

ext.24<-dat%>%
  group_by(new.Date,TRT.2022,TRT.2023)%>%
  identify_outliers(resp)%>%
  filter(is.extreme==TRUE )
ext.24

mod.check<-lmer(resp~as.factor(new.Date)*TRT.2022*TRT.2023+(1|Plot),data=dat)
# performance::check_model(mod.check)

plot(mod.check)
qqnorm(resid(mod.check));qqline(resid(mod.check))
shapiro.test(resid(mod.check)) # close but fail 0.002
leveneTest(resp ~ as.factor(new.Date)*TRT.2022*TRT.2023,data=dat) # close 0.011

outlierTest(mod.check) # no outliers
# view(dat)
dat.24<-dat

#### 2024 mod ####
mod.check<-lmer(log(resp)~as.factor(new.Date)*TRT.2022*TRT.2023+(1|Plot),data=dat)
plot(mod.check)
qqnorm(resid(mod.check));qqline(resid(mod.check))
shapiro.test(resid(mod.check)) # close but fail 0.005
leveneTest(log(resp)~as.factor(new.Date)*TRT.2022*TRT.2023,data=dat) # OK!

anova(mod.check,ddf="Kenward-Roger")

step(mod.check)

mod.red<-lmer(log(resp)~as.factor(new.Date)+TRT.2022+TRT.2023+as.factor(new.Date)*TRT.2023+(1|Plot),data=dat)
plot(mod.red)
qqnorm(resid(mod.red));qqline(resid(mod.red))
anova(mod.red,ddf="Kenward-Roger")

```

```{r VWC comparisons for growing seasons}
#### 2022 growing season ####
str(dat.22) # 800 observations

## Analysis
gs.avs.22<-dat.22%>%
  group_by(Plot,TRT.2022)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.samp.dates = n(),
    season.av = mean(resp),
    season.sd = sd(resp),
    season.SE = season.sd/sqrt(n.samp.dates))

## ANOVA
gs.22<-lm(season.av~TRT.2022,data=gs.avs.22)
shapiro.test(resid(gs.22)) # fine
leveneTest(season.av~TRT.2022,data=gs.avs.22) # 0.02, use Welch's t-test

Anova(gs.22,type=3) # significant

## T-test
ggplot(gs.avs.22, aes(x = season.av, fill = TRT.2022)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)

shapiro.test(gs.avs.22$season.av[gs.avs.22$TRT.2022 == "amb"]) # fine
shapiro.test(gs.avs.22$season.av[gs.avs.22$TRT.2022 == "wet"]) # fine

t.test(season.av~TRT.2022,data=gs.avs.22) # p < 0.0001

p.22.val<-"p < 0.0001 with Welch's t-test. t = -10.26, df = 31.453"

## Plot
gs.plot.avs.22<-gs.avs.22%>%
  group_by(TRT.2022)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.plots=n(),
    av = mean(season.av),
    sd = sd(season.av),
    SE = sd/sqrt(n.plots))

fi.name<-"fig_exports/VWC/No_Outliers/New/SGS_EW_2022_VWC_gs_v2.pdf"
y.lab<-expression(paste(bold("20 cm Soil"["VWC"]*" (%)")))
ylims=c(0,55)
p.22.val
p.val="p < 0.0001"
text.y=37

gs.22.plot<-ggplot(data=gs.plot.avs.22,aes(x=TRT.2022,y=av,color=TRT.2022,fill=TRT.2022))+
  labs(title=expression(bold("2022")),y=y.lab,x=NULL,tag="")+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=ylims,expand=c(0,0),sec.axis=dup_axis(labels=NULL,name=NULL))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("amb"="D","wet"="A"),
                   # expand=expansion(0.85)
                   )+
  geom_col_pattern(width=0.75,
                   aes(pattern=TRT.2022,fill=TRT.2022),color="black",
                   pattern_color="white",
                   pattern_fill=NA,
                   pattern_density=0.2,
                   pattern_spacing=0.04,
                   pattern_alpha=0.75,
                   pattern_aspect_ratio=0.1,
                   )+
  # geom_bar(width=0.75,
  #          aes)
  scale_fill_manual(name=NULL,
                    values=c("#F8D48C","#B3BEDE"))+
  # scale_pattern_manual(values=c("stripe",NA))+
  scale_pattern_manual(values=c(NA,NA))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=av-SE,ymax=av+SE),
                position=position_dodge(0.75),
                width=0.1,linewidth=0.25,
                color="black")+
  # scale_color_manual(name=NULL,
  #                    values=c("#F4B942","#4059AD"))+
  coord_cartesian(clip="off")+
  plot_theme+
  theme(axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1,size=9))+
  geom_text(data=subset(gs.plot.avs.22,TRT.2022=="amb"),
            label=p.val,
            x=1.5,y=text.y,
            color="black",
            size=9/.pt)+
  force_panelsizes(rows = unit(1.25,"in"),
                   cols = unit(0.85, "in"))
  
gs.22.plot

# ggsave(gs.22.plot,filename=fi.name,height=3,width=3)

#### 2023 growing season ####
str(dat.23) # 739 observations

## Analysis
gs.avs.23<-dat.23%>%
  group_by(Plot,TRT.2022,TRT.2023)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.samp.dates = n(),
    season.av = mean(resp),
    season.sd = sd(resp),
    season.SE = season.sd/sqrt(n.samp.dates))

## ANOVA
gs.23<-lm(season.av~TRT.2022*TRT.2023,data=gs.avs.23)
plot(gs.23,1)
qqnorm(resid(gs.23));qqline(resid(gs.23))

shapiro.test(resid(gs.23)) # fine
leveneTest(season.av~TRT.2022*TRT.2023,data=gs.avs.23) # fine

Anova(gs.23,type=3) # interaction not significant
pairs(emmeans(gs.23,pairwise~TRT.2022|TRT.2023)) # amb 2023 p = 0.0580 for legacy, wet 2023 p = 0.0113 for legacy

p.23.amb<-"Emmeans pairwise p = 0.0580 (t ratio = -1.958, df = 36), interaction main effect n.s."
p.23.wet<-"Emmeans pairwise p = 0.0113 (t ratio = -2.672, df = 36), interaction main effect n.s."

gs.23.ni<-lm(season.av~TRT.2022+TRT.2023,data=gs.avs.23)
shapiro.test(resid(gs.23.ni)) # fine
Anova(gs.23.ni,type=3) # both significant

## T-test
ggplot(subset(gs.avs.23,TRT.2023=="wet"), aes(x = season.av, fill = TRT.2022)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)

shapiro.test(gs.avs.23$season.av[gs.avs.23$TRT.2022 == "amb" & 
                                   gs.avs.23$TRT.2023=="wet"]) # fine
shapiro.test(gs.avs.23$season.av[gs.avs.23$TRT.2022 == "wet" & 
                                   gs.avs.23$TRT.2023=="wet"]) # fine

t.test(season.av ~ TRT.2022, data=subset(gs.avs.23,TRT.2023=="wet")) # p = 0.007677


ggplot(subset(gs.avs.23,TRT.2023=="amb"), aes(x = season.av, fill = TRT.2022)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)
shapiro.test(gs.avs.23$season.av[gs.avs.23$TRT.2022 == "amb" & 
                                   gs.avs.23$TRT.2023=="amb"]) # fine
shapiro.test(gs.avs.23$season.av[gs.avs.23$TRT.2022 == "wet" & 
                                   gs.avs.23$TRT.2023=="amb"]) # fine

t.test(season.av ~ TRT.2022, data=subset(gs.avs.23,TRT.2023=="amb")) # p = 0.093


## Plot
gs.plot.avs.23<-gs.avs.23%>%
  group_by(TRT.2022,TRT.2023)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.plots=n(),
    av = mean(season.av),
    sd = sd(season.av),
    SE = sd/sqrt(n.plots))


fi.name<-"fig_exports/VWC/No_Outliers/New/SGS_EW_2023_VWC_gs_ANOVA.pdf"
# fi.name<-"fig_exports/VWC/No_Outliers/New/SGS_EW_2023_VWC_gs.pdf"
y.lab<-expression(paste(bold("20 cm Soil"["VWC"]*" (%)")))
ylims=c(0,55)
text.y.amb=40
text.y.wet=46

# ANOVA emmeans
p.23.amb
p.val.amb="p = 0.0580"
p.23.wet
p.val.wet="p = 0.0113"

# t-tests
```

```{r VWC mid and late periods}
#### 2022 ####
str(dat.22) # 800 observations

## Analysis
periods.22<-dat.22%>%
  mutate(period=case_when(
    new.Date <= ymd("2022-07-06") ~ "early-mid",
    new.Date > ymd("2022-07-06") ~ "mid-late"))%>%
  mutate(period=factor(period,levels=c("early-mid","mid-late")))
str(periods.22)

### <- full ANOVAs ####
log.per.22<-lmer(log(resp)~TRT.2022*period+(1|Plot/period),data=periods.22)
plot(log.per.22)
qqnorm(resid(log.per.22));qqline(resid(log.per.22))
shapiro.test(resid(log.per.22)) # fails but graphically looks decent
leveneTest(log(resp)~TRT.2022*period, data=periods.22) # fail but graphically looks ok

anova(log.per.22,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # drop interaction
pairs(emmeans(log.per.22,pairwise~TRT.2022|period)) # both < 0.0001

p.full.22.early<-"Emmeans pairwise p < 0.0001 (t ratio -8.870, df = 86.2)"
p.full.22.late<-"Emmeans pairwise p < 0.0001 (t ratio -9.759, df = 53.2)"

step(log.per.22,reduce.random=FALSE) # keep 2022 trt only 

log.per.22.red<-lmer(log(resp)~TRT.2022+(1|Plot/period),data=periods.22)
anova(log.per.22.red,ddf="Kenward-Roger")

anova(log.per.22,log.per.22.red) # prefer reduced model

# check pairwise comps of best model
pairs(emmeans(log.per.22.red,pairwise~TRT.2022)) # sig. different (<0.0001) averaged across periods

#### <- averages ANOVAs & T-tests ####
season.22.avs<-dat.22%>%
  mutate(period=case_when(
    new.Date <= ymd("2022-07-06") ~ "early-mid",
    new.Date > ymd("2022-07-06") ~ "mid-late"))%>%
  group_by(Plot,period,TRT.2022)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.samp.dates = n(),
    season.av = mean(resp),
    season.sd = sd(resp),
    season.SE = season.sd/sqrt(n.samp.dates))

season.22.avs.mod<-lmer(season.av~period*TRT.2022+(1|Plot),data=season.22.avs)
plot(season.22.avs.mod)
qqnorm(resid(season.22.avs.mod));qqline(resid(season.22.avs.mod))
anova(season.22.avs.mod,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # all significant
pairs(emmeans(season.22.avs.mod,pairwise~TRT.2022|period)) 

p.seas.22.early<-"Emmeans pairwise p < 0.0001 (t ratio -10.639, df = 51.2"
p.seas.22.late<-"Emmeans pairwise p < 0.0001 (t ratio -8.808, df = 51.2"

step(season.22.avs.mod) # no reduction

### early to mid period
early.22.avs<-dat.22%>%
  mutate(period=case_when(
    new.Date <= ymd("2022-07-06") ~ "early-mid",
    new.Date > ymd("2022-07-06") ~ "mid-late"))%>%
  filter(period == "early-mid")%>%
  group_by(Plot,TRT.2022)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.samp.dates = n(),
    season.av = mean(resp),
    season.sd = sd(resp),
    season.SE = season.sd/sqrt(n.samp.dates))

str(early.22.avs)

## ANOVA
early.22<-lm(season.av~TRT.2022,data=early.22.avs)
shapiro.test(resid(early.22)) # fine
leveneTest(season.av~TRT.2022,data=early.22.avs) # 0.007, use Welch's for t-test

Anova(early.22,type=3) # significant

## T-test
ggplot(early.22.avs, aes(x = season.av, fill = TRT.2022)) +

shapiro.test(early.22.avs$season.av[early.22.avs$TRT.2022 == "wet"]) # fine

shapiro.test(late.22.avs$season.av[late.22.avs$TRT.2022 == "wet"]) # fine

    season.sd = sd(resp),
    season.SE = season.sd/sqrt(n.samp.dates))

wet.recent.avs.24<-subset(period.avs.24,TRT.2023=="wet")
amb.recent.avs.24<-subset(period.avs.24,TRT.2023=="amb")

#### full combined season ANOVAs ####
season.24.avs.mod<-lmer(season.av ~ period*TRT.2022*TRT.2023+(1|Plot),data=period.avs.24)
plot(season.24.avs.mod)
qqnorm(resid(season.24.avs.mod));qqline(resid(season.24.avs.mod))
anova(season.24.avs.mod,ddf="Kenward-Roger")
pairs(emmeans(season.24.avs.mod,~TRT.2022|TRT.2023|period))

p.seas.24.amb_early<-"Emmeans pairwise p = 0.0602 (t ratio = -1.918, df = 56.1), main effect of interaction n.s."
p.seas.24.wet_early<-"Emmeans pairwise p = 0.1105 (t ratio = -1.621, df = 56.1), main effect of interaction n.s."
p.seas.24.amb_late<-"Emmeans pairwise p = 0.5920 (t ratio = -0.539, df = 56.1), main effect of interaction n.s."
p.seas.24.wet_late<-"Emmeans pairwise p = 0.1143 (t ratio = -1.604, df = 56.1), main effect of interaction n.s."

step(season.24.avs.mod)
season.24.avs.mod.red<-lmer(season.av ~ TRT.2022 + (1|Plot), data = period.avs.24)
plot(season.24.avs.mod.red)
qqnorm(resid(season.24.avs.mod.red));qqline(resid(season.24.avs.mod.red))
anova(season.24.avs.mod.red,ddf="Kenward-Roger")

#### <- wet 2023 ####

anova(wet.23.mod,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # drop interaction
pairs(emmeans(wet.23.mod,pairwise~TRT.2022|period)) # early 0.1601, late 9,1796

pairs(emmeans(wet.23.mod.ni,pairwise~TRT.2022)) # p = 0.0658

## seasonal ANOVAs
```

## GCC 

```{r GCC data}
#### GCC Full data ####
gcc<-read.csv("final_data/SGS_EW_GCC_2022-2024.csv")
str(gcc)

gcc.no.na<-gcc%>%
  # set date formats
  mutate(new.Date=as.Date(Date,format="%m/%d/%y"),yr=year(new.Date),mon=month(new.Date))%>%
  mutate(short.Date=paste("2024",mon,day(new.Date),sep="-"))%>%
  mutate(short.Date=as.Date(short.Date,format="%Y-%m-%d"))%>%
  # rename variables from original file
  rename(TRT.2022=TRT_2022)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2022=factor(TRT.2022,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  rename(TRT.2023=TRT_2023)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2023=factor(TRT.2023,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  # select columns to keep
  rename(Notes=Notes.)%>%
  select(c(new.Date,short.Date,yr,mon,Plot,TRT.2022,TRT.2023,GCC,Notes))%>%
  # drop rows with VWC NA's
  drop_na(GCC)%>%
  # create Unique_ID for dropping specific observations (outliers)
  mutate(Unique_ID=paste(new.Date,"_Plot",Plot,sep=""))

str(gcc) # 1880 observations
str(gcc.no.na) # 19870 observations

gcc.2024<-subset(gcc.no.na,yr=="2024")
gcc.2023<-subset(gcc.no.na,yr=="2023")
gcc.2022<-subset(gcc.no.na,yr=="2022")
```

```{r GCC mid and late periods}
#### 2022 ####
str(dat.22) # 793 observations

## Analysis
periods.22<-dat.22%>%
  mutate(period=case_when(
    new.Date <= ymd("2022-07-06") ~ "early-mid",
    new.Date > ymd("2022-07-06") ~ "mid-late"))%>%
  mutate(period=factor(period,levels=c("early-mid","mid-late")))
str(periods.22)

#### <- full ANOVAs ####
log.per.22<-lmer(log(resp)~TRT.2022*period+(1|Plot/period),data=periods.22)
plot(log.per.22)
qqnorm(resid(log.per.22));qqline(resid(log.per.22))
shapiro.test(resid(log.per.22)) # fails

anova(log.per.22,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # all significant
step(log.per.22,reduce.random=FALSE) # keep all

# check pairwise comps of best model
pairs(emmeans(log.per.22,pairwise~TRT.2022|period)) # sig. different for both periods (< 0.0001)

#### <- averages ANOVAs & T-tests ####
season.22.avs<-dat.22%>%
  mutate(period=case_when(
    new.Date <= ymd("2022-07-06") ~ "early-mid",
    new.Date > ymd("2022-07-06") ~ "mid-late"))%>%
  group_by(Plot,period,TRT.2022)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.samp.dates = n(),
    season.av = mean(resp),
    season.sd = sd(resp),
    season.SE = season.sd/sqrt(n.samp.dates))

season.22.avs.mod<-lmer(season.av~period*TRT.2022+(1|Plot),data=season.22.avs)
plot(season.22.avs.mod)
leveneTest(season.av~period*TRT.2022,data=season.22.avs) # fails
qqnorm(resid(season.22.avs.mod));qqline(resid(season.22.avs.mod))
shapiro.test(resid(season.22.avs.mod)) # fails - transformations do literally nothing
anova(season.22.avs.mod,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # all significant
pairs(emmeans(season.22.avs.mod,pairwise~TRT.2022|period))

p.seas.22.early<-"Emmeans pairwise p < 0.0001 (t ratio = -8.445, df = 51.5)"
p.seas.22.late<-"Emmeans pairwise p < 0.0001 (t ratio = -16.915, df = 51.5)"

### early to mid period
early.22.avs<-dat.22%>%
  mutate(period=case_when(
    new.Date <= ymd("2022-07-06") ~ "early-mid",
    new.Date > ymd("2022-07-06") ~ "mid-late"))%>%
  filter(period == "early-mid")%>%
  group_by(Plot,TRT.2022)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.samp.dates = n(),
    season.av = mean(resp),
    season.sd = sd(resp),
    season.SE = season.sd/sqrt(n.samp.dates))

str(early.22.avs)

## ANOVA

shapiro.test(resid(early.22)) # fine
leveneTest(season.av~TRT.2022,data=early.22.avs) # 0.00001, use Welch's for t-test

Anova(early.22,type=3) # significant
pairs(emmeans(early.22,pairwise~TRT.2022)) # < 0.0001

## T-test
ggplot(early.22.avs, aes(x = season.av, fill = TRT.2022)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)

shapiro.test(early.22.avs$season.av[early.22.avs$TRT.2022 == "amb"]) # fine
shapiro.test(early.22.avs$season.av[early.22.avs$TRT.2022 == "wet"]) # fine

t.test(season.av ~ TRT.2022, data = early.22.avs) # p < 0.0001

  dplyr::summarise(
    n.plots=n(),

### mid to late period

  dplyr::summarise(

shapiro.test(late.22.avs$season.av[late.22.avs$TRT.2022 == "wet"]) # fine
```

## Respiration

```{r Resp data}
#### Efflux Full data ####
resp<-read.csv("final_data/SGS_EW_Efflux_2022-2023.csv")
str(resp)

resp[resp=="ambient"]<-"amb"

resp.no.na<-resp%>%
  # set date formats
  mutate(new.Date=as.Date(Full.Date,format="%m/%d/%y"),yr=year(new.Date),mon=month(new.Date))%>%
  mutate(short.Date=paste("2024",mon,day(new.Date),sep="-"))%>%
  mutate(short.Date=as.Date(short.Date,format="%Y-%m-%d"))%>%
  # rename variables from original file
  rename(TRT.2022=TRT_2022)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2022=factor(TRT.2022,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  rename(TRT.2023=TRT_2023)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2023=factor(TRT.2023,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  # select columns to keep
  select(c(new.Date,short.Date,yr,mon,Plot,TRT.2022,TRT.2023,Soil.temp,Efflux,Notes))%>%
  # drop rows with VWC NA's
  drop_na(Efflux)%>%
  # create Unique_ID for dropping specific observations (outliers)
  mutate(Unique_ID=paste(new.Date,"_Plot",Plot,sep=""))

str(resp) # 721 observations
str(resp.no.na) # 712 observations

resp.2023<-subset(resp.no.na,yr=="2023")
resp.2022<-subset(resp.no.na,yr=="2022")
```

```{r Resp mid and late periods}
qqnorm(resid(wet.23.avs.mod));qqline(resid(wet.23.avs.mod))
anova(wet.23.avs.mod,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # only period sig
pairs(emmeans(wet.23.avs.mod,pairwise~TRT.2022|period)) # early 0.4342, late 0.0539

wet.23.avs.mod.ni<-lmer(season.av~period+TRT.2022+(1|Plot),data=wet.avs.23)
plot(wet.23.avs.mod.ni)
qqnorm(resid(wet.23.avs.mod.ni));qqline(resid(wet.23.avs.mod.ni))
anova(wet.23.avs.mod.ni,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # only period sig.

## T-tests
### early 
ggplot(subset(wet.avs.23, period == "early-mid"), aes(x = season.av, fill = TRT.2022)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)

shapiro.test(wet.avs.23$season.av[wet.avs.23$TRT.2022 == "amb" &
                                    wet.avs.23$period == "early-mid"]) # fine
shapiro.test(wet.avs.23$season.av[wet.avs.23$TRT.2022 == "wet" & 
                                    wet.avs.23$period == "early-mid"]) # fine

t.test(season.av ~ TRT.2022, data = subset(wet.avs.23,period=="early-mid")) # p = 0.327

### late
ggplot(subset(wet.avs.23, period == "mid-late"), aes(x = season.av, fill = TRT.2022)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)

shapiro.test(wet.avs.23$season.av[wet.avs.23$TRT.2022 == "amb" &
                                    wet.avs.23$period == "mid-late"]) # fine
shapiro.test(wet.avs.23$season.av[wet.avs.23$TRT.2022 == "wet" & 
                                    wet.avs.23$period == "mid-late"]) # fine

t.test(season.av ~ TRT.2022, data = subset(wet.avs.23,period=="mid-late")) # p = 0.1277

#### <- amb 2023 ####
## full ANOVAs
amb.23.mod<-lmer(resp~period*TRT.2022+(1|Plot/period),data=amb.23)
plot(amb.23.mod)
qqnorm(resid(amb.23.mod));qqline(resid(amb.23.mod))
anova(amb.23.mod,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # drop interaction
pairs(emmeans(amb.23.mod,pairwise~TRT.2022|period)) # early p = 0.6775, late p = 0.0350

amb.23.mod.ni<-lmer(resp~period+TRT.2022+(1|Plot/period),data=amb.23)
anova(amb.23.mod.ni,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # TRT.2022 p = 0.08 across periods
pairs(emmeans(amb.23.mod.ni,pairwise~TRT.2022)) # 0.0833

## seasonal ANOVAs
amb.23.avs.mod<-lmer(season.av~period*TRT.2022+(1|Plot),data=amb.avs.23)
plot(amb.23.avs.mod)
qqnorm(resid(amb.23.avs.mod));qqline(resid(amb.23.avs.mod))
anova(amb.23.avs.mod,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # drop interaction
pairs(emmeans(amb.23.avs.mod,pairwise~TRT.2022|period)) # early p = 0.6582, late p = 0.0326

amb.23.avs.mod.ni<-lmer(season.av~period+TRT.2022+(1|Plot),data=amb.avs.23)
anova(amb.23.avs.mod.ni,ddf="Kenward-Roger") # TRT.2022 p = 0.0908
pairs(emmeans(amb.23.avs.mod.ni,pairwise~TRT.2022)) # p = 0.0908

## T-tests
### early 
ggplot(subset(amb.avs.23, period == "early-mid"), aes(x = season.av, fill = TRT.2022)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)

shapiro.test(amb.avs.23$season.av[amb.avs.23$TRT.2022 == "amb" &
                                    amb.avs.23$period == "early-mid"]) # fails
shapiro.test(amb.avs.23$season.av[amb.avs.23$TRT.2022 == "wet" & 
                                    amb.avs.23$period == "early-mid"]) # fine

t.test(season.av ~ TRT.2022, data = subset(amb.avs.23,period=="early-mid")) # p = 0.7147
wilcox.test(season.av ~ TRT.2022, data = subset(amb.avs.23,period=="early-mid")) # p = 0.5476

### late
ggplot(subset(amb.avs.23, period == "mid-late"), aes(x = season.av, fill = TRT.2022)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)

shapiro.test(amb.avs.23$season.av[amb.avs.23$TRT.2022 == "amb" &
                                    amb.avs.23$period == "mid-late"]) # fine
shapiro.test(amb.avs.23$season.av[amb.avs.23$TRT.2022 == "wet" & 
                                    amb.avs.23$period == "mid-late"]) # fine

t.test(season.av ~ TRT.2022, data = subset(amb.avs.23,period=="mid-late")) # p = 0.0187

## Plot

  group_by(period,TRT.2022,TRT.2023)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.plots=n(),
    av = mean(season.av),
    sd = sd(season.av),
    SE = sd/sqrt(n.plots))

wet.plot.avs.23<-subset(periods.plot.avs.23,TRT.2023=="wet")
amb.plot.avs.23<-subset(periods.plot.avs.23,TRT.2023=="amb")

                    values=fill.col

                    )+

        )+
```
